title: NagaWorld workers’ strike, begun 18 December 2021
summary: RFA Khmer reports the nonviolent strike began on 18 December 2021 outside NagaWorld in Phnom Penh, and says more than 100 workers remained on strike in December 2024. It describes protests occurring almost monthly over three years but gives no December 2024 specific gathering/time/site headcount. The 1,300 figure refers to layoffs in April 2021, not protest attendance. Workers’ primary demands are directed to the company; union commentary calls for Labor Ministry mediation and independent state action, but this article alone does not establish a discrete December public gathering meeting MM criteria.
notes: Record as a cross-month continuity/action lead, not a new December event. Do not treat company workforce/layoff figures as turnout or assign the approximate monthly recurrence to a specific December date.
